name: Salty Sailor Tavern
summary: In Booty Bay, travelers from both factions find shelter at the Salty Sailor Tavern. Goblin Innkeeper Skindle runs the port's inn and watering hole, where scoundrels and mercenaries seek respite from the jungle.

sections.title: A Safe Haven in the Jungle
sections.body: Among Booty Bay's wooden tiers, the Salty Sailor Tavern offers warm beds and strong drinks. The Blackwater Raiders watch over the place. Innkeeper Skindle tends the bar as buccaneers, traders, and adventurers mingle on neutral ground. Outside hangs a massive Zul'Gurub Protector Stone, a curious trophy in this den of commerce.

faq.q: Who runs the Salty Sailor Tavern?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Skindle, an industrious goblin, runs the tavern and its inn. Sailors, mercenaries, and adventurers passing through Booty Bay come to drink and rest.

faq.q: What is that large stone hanging outside the tavern?
faq.answer: A Zul'Gurub Protector Stone hangs outside the tavern. It is an ominous relic brought back from ancient troll ruins deep in the jungle.

faq.q: Can both Alliance and Horde stay here?
faq.answer: Yes. The Steamwheedle Cartel keeps Booty Bay neutral, so Alliance and Horde travelers may rest at the tavern. They must mind their manners and keep their weapons sheathed.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can trade rumors and listen for pirate chatter on the Salty Sailor's crowded, smoky floor. Keep your purse guarded.
